31	(`isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced`), and both halves are
32	assembled from the charts:

38	  from them via `IsReduced.of_openCover` (`isReduced_p1`);

40	  is a nonempty open subset of the irreducible `V₀`, hence irreducible and
41	  dense in `V₀`; symmetrically dense in `V₁`; and `V₀ ∪ V₁ = X`, so `W` is a
